statement: Copper objects in the holdout whose inscription exactly matches a copper-tablet text from the exploration split carry the same image label (Wells/ICIT motif code, field 'motif') that the frozen lookup table predicts for that text, more often than when labels are shuffled among all holdout copper objects with a non-vague label. Lookup: for each exploration copper text, its majority non-vague label (ties dropped); 'Othr' counts as a label, 'unknown' and empty do not. Exploration: same-text pairs share an image 99% vs 10% shuffled; independent excavation drawings (Mackay 1937, Marshall 1931) agree for every set drawn more than once (results/copper_sets.md). Settings: duplicates kept (identical tablets are the point of the test). Planned support: about 13-18 looked-up holdout objects, estimated from the exploration share of repeated texts, not from the holdout; the analyst has not read any holdout copper text. If support is below the project minimum of 15, the result is reported as below planned support, whatever its p-value. One-sided.
author: Erin (RN-Top); prepared by Claude
